claim_groups.supported_paraphrase: In his2022 interview, Deo traced the work to a proposed cinema-history column in Dharitri’s Sunday supplement Chhutidina, developed with Gopal Mohapatra and Bibhuti Mishra. He recalled difficulty finding dependable information and Akshaya Mohanty’s advice to consult old newspapers.
claim_groups.limits: Retrospective testimony. About25years ago is approximate, not a proven foundingdate. Scan newspapers means research/read them here, not proof ofdigital scanning.

claim_groups.supported_paraphrase: Deo credited journalists, Forum members and film workers. Srikant Mohanty of Puri, publisher of Manoranjan, entrusted magazines, songbooks and photographs to him; Deo recalled hiring a mini-truck to transport the collection to Bhubaneswar. He said he reserved part of his earnings for the work.
claim_groups.limits: Do not invent conversation, weather, journey scene, quantity or costs; collaborator identity from testimony.
